name: whip-run
displayName: Whip Run: Whip Claude Into Shape
description: An endless-runner game across the bottom of your real screen while Claude Code works. Jump bugs, smash 500 errors, and whip Claude when he slacks off.
author: Yashasvi Jhala

commands.title: Whip Run: Connect to Claude Code
Whip Run: Disconnect from Claude Code

whipRun.reactToClaude.description: Show live reactions on screen while Claude Code works: paper airplanes for edits, a sign for commands, a magnifying glass for searches. Needs the Claude Code connection.

whipRun.cameoAfterSeconds.description: Seconds Claude Code must work before the cowboy starts dropping by on his own.

whipRun.notifyWhenDone.description: Show a notification when Claude Code finishes or needs your input.

whipRun.sound.description: Play whip cracks, yelps and level-up jingles.

whipRun.electronPath.description: Path to an Electron binary for the overlay. Leave empty and Whip Run finds or downloads one.
